mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS comment_id, c.food_id, c.content, c.created_at, ci.id AS checkin_id, ci.eaten_on, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM food_comment c INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN food_checkin ci ON ci.comment_id = c.id AND ci.visibility = 'PUBLIC' WHERE c.food_id = #{foodId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_comment (food_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{foodId}, #{author.id}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE food_comment SET content=#{content} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM food_comment WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
